_doc: OPS-DEPLOY-PROVENANCE-AND-VERDICT-CLASS-W1 CH2 — config for scripts/check-test-budget.mjs. A test that SPAWNS A PROCESS must declare its own { timeout: N }. The 5,000 ms vitest default is calibrated for pure-function assertions; a test that shells out to a compiler inherits it silently and then fails on a slower CI runner as a TIMEOUT, which reads as a regression and blocks every concurrent wave's deploy. That is not hypothetical: it happened on 2026-08-17 and blocked PRICING-BOT-DELIVERY-METERING-W1's render for ~3 days.
_scope: PROCESS SPAWN ONLY — child_process / execFileSync / execSync / spawnSync / spawn(. Deliberately NOT widened to filesystem or network I/O: that is the class with a proven live failure, and a widened detector over ~6,000 tests would red files this wave does not own. Widening is OPS-TEST-BUDGET-WIDEN-W1, once the spawn class is quiet.
_promoteOn_semantics: THE GATE ENFORCES THIS DATE ITSELF. Before it, a backlog entry REPORTS. On or after it, a backlog entry FAILS — no human flips a flag, no follow-up wave is required, and the gate warns loudly in its output for the 7 days before. A dated promise living in a comment is prose, and CLAUDE.md is explicit that a rule which has once failed as prose must be retired into a gate or deleted. The nearest precedent, ops/monitoring/sot-parity-config.json, states its promotion criterion as prose to be 'counted by the operator' and names a W{NEXT} owner to flip it — that is the shape this file deliberately does NOT copy.
_owner_semantics: The wave that owns clearing the backlog below. Named HERE, in the config the gate reads, not only in a follow-up table — a follow-up table is not machine-readable and does not survive the wave that wrote it.
_backlog_semantics: SHRINK-ONLY, keyed by file + block title. The gate FAILS if this list GROWS, or if a spawning block appears that is not on it. Without that, report-mode is a permanent hiding place rather than a bounded migration — which would be 'changed-files-only' wearing this file's label. Entries are removed as their owners add an explicit timeout; the list may never gain one.
_new_and_changed_are_blocking_today: Independently of promoteOn, any spawning block in a test file that is NEW or MODIFIED versus the merge-base with origin/main FAILS immediately. The backlog grandfathers history; it grants nothing to work being written now.
